items.title: AT&T (T) Starts Work On 54 Acre Plano Headquarters Campus
items.summary: AT&T (NYSE:T) has begun building a new 54 acre global headquarters campus in Plano, Texas for its Dallas Fort Worth workforce. The project is planned as a highly connected workspace that uses AT&T fiber optic and 5G infrastructure across the consolidated campus. Teams currently spread across multiple Dallas Fort Worth locations are expected to be brought together at the Plano site once construction is completed.
